postings.title: AI Architect (Classic ML + Agentic AI) - R01573598
postings.description:
We are looking for an 8–12 years experienced Conversational AI professional with strong hands-on expertise in NLP/NLU, dialogue management, and chatbot/virtual assistant development.
The candidate should have worked with platforms like RASA, Kore.ai, Dialogflow, or IBM Watson. Experience with LLMs, GenAI/RAG, Azure AI, speech/ASR, and AI translation will be an added advantage.
This is a senior role, so we need someone who can design the solution, own the technical architecture, and guide the development team, rather than someone with only general Data Science experience.


Primary Skills
- Dialogue Design, Syntax and semantic analysis, Reinforcement learning, Text Classification, Governance for Conversational AI, RASA, Natural Language Understanding (NLU), Kore.ai, GDF (Google Dialog Flow), IBM Watson, Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Dialogue Management (NLG), Spark NLP, Recurrent Neural Networks, Conv AI Testing

Specialization
- Conversational AI: Senior Data Scientist

Job requirements
Conversational AI Architect / Lead – AI Translation & Conversational Intelligence

Experience: 8–12 Years
Locations: Bangalore | Hyderabad | Pune | Chennai | Gurgaon
Role: Conversational AI Architect / Lead
Employment Type: Full-time

Build the Next Generation of Enterprise Conversational AI

Are you passionate about building intelligent systems that understand, interact, and communicate naturally with users?

We are looking for an experienced Conversational AI Architect / Lead to design and build enterprise-scale conversational and AI-driven solutions. This role is ideal for someone with strong expertise across Conversational AI, NLP/NLU, dialogue systems, LLMs, Azure AI, RASA, Kore.ai and enterprise AI architecture.

You will work on advanced AI translation and conversational intelligence solutions, combining dialogue design, Natural Language Processing, speech technologies, knowledge grounding, and modern AI platforms to create scalable and reliable enterprise experiences.

What You’ll Do

- Architect and lead enterprise-grade Conversational AI and AI translation solutions.

- Design scalable dialogue architectures across virtual assistants, conversational applications, and AI-driven user experiences.

- Develop and optimize dialogue management, NLP/NLU, semantic understanding, text classification, and Natural Language Generation (NLG) solutions.

- Apply machine learning and reinforcement learning techniques to improve dialogue quality, contextual understanding, and user experience.

- Design solutions leveraging RASA, Kore.ai, Google Dialogflow, IBM Watson, and related Conversational AI technologies.

- Architect and drive integrations with Azure AI services, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and enterprise applications.

- Implement knowledge-grounding strategies using enterprise content and SharePoint-based data sources.

- Work with speech technologies, including Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and conversational speech processing.

- Define security, governance, compliance, monitoring, and engineering standards for enterprise AI solutions.

- Lead testing and validation of Conversational AI systems to improve accuracy, reliability, and overall response quality.

- Design scalable cloud deployment models for AI applications.

- Guide Data Scientists, AI Engineers, and developers through solution design, code reviews, best practices, and implementation approaches.

- Collaborate with business, product, engineering, and architecture teams to translate complex requirements into practical AI solutions.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Have Skills

- 8–12 years of overall experience across Data Science, AI/ML, NLP, or related engineering domains.

- Strong hands-on experience in Conversational AI and enterprise dialogue systems.

- Expertise in dialogue design and dialogue management.

- Strong knowledge of Natural Language Processing, NLU, NLG, semantic analysis, and text classification.

- Hands-on experience with RASA and/or Kore.ai.

- Experience with Conversational AI platforms such as Google Dialogflow or IBM Watson.

- Strong understanding of AI/ML and deep learning techniques used in conversational systems.

- Experience with Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and speech-based conversational applications.

- Experience designing scalable enterprise AI architectures.

- Knowledge of technical governance, security, and compliance requirements for enterprise AI applications.

- Strong stakeholder communication and technical leadership capabilities.

Technical Skills

Core: Conversational AI | NLP | NLU | NLG | Dialogue Management | Semantic Analysis | Text Classification | LLMs | AI/ML

Platforms & Frameworks: RASA | Kore.ai | Google Dialogflow | IBM Watson | Azure AI

Additional Technologies: Spark NLP | ASR | RNNs | Microsoft Teams | SharePoint | Cloud AI Services

Good

postings.title: AI Builder (Forward Deployed Engineer)
postings.description:
About Brillio: 

Brillio is one of the fastest growing digital technology service providers and a partner of choice for many Fortune 1000 companies seeking to turn disruption into a competitive advantage through innovative digital adoption. Brillio, renowned for its world-class professionals, referred to as "Brillians", distinguishes itself through their capacity to seamlessly integrate cutting-edge digital and design thinking skills with an unwavering dedication to client satisfaction. 
Brillio takes pride in its status as an employer of choice, consistently attracting the most exceptional and talented individuals due to its unwavering emphasis on contemporary, groundbreaking technologies, and exclusive digital projects. Brillio's relentless commitment to providing an exceptional experience to its Brillians and nurturing their full potential consistently garners them the Great Place to Work® certification year after year.

Brillio is an AI-first technology company, backed by private equity, Bain Capital and Orogen Group, partnering with enterprise organizations to drive AI-led transformation at scale. We focus on industries where technology directly impacts growth financial services, healthcare, consumer, telecom and technology.
To make that happen, we work closely with executive teams and operate alongside our clients to deploy AI into core business systems moving from strategy to execution.
 
Our Team
We bring together three distinct layers of capability:
AI-Native Engineers: Engineers, Architects and Product leaders who are native to AI systems designing, building, and scaling production-grade solutions.
Leadership: Leaders who have delivered large-scale, global transformation programs — combining business insight with execution discipline
Board & Advisors: Providing strategic oversight, governance, and perspective across complex enterprise environments
 
What You'll Do?
Problem Discovery & Solution Design
• Engage directly with business stakeholders, VPs, clinical leads, operations owners to surface ambiguous, high-value problems and translate them into buildable AI opportunities
• Ask sharp questions, challenge assumptions, and define what a minimum viable AI solution looks like before writing a line of code
• Map existing processes end-to-end, identify where AI can eliminate friction, reduce cost, or accelerate decisions and communicate your findings in business terms
•  Build lightweight scoping documents and ROI estimates that align stakeholders and set clear success criteria before development begins

Rapid Prototyping & Full-Stack AI Development
• Design and build working AI prototypes within days using Claude and the modern AI development stack
• Develop full-stack AI applications spanning LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, REST API integrations, and lightweight front-end interfaces
• Own your technical architecture end-to-end from prompt design to data pipeline to user interface and be able to explain every design decision to both engineering and business audiences
• Iterate based on real user feedback in the field ship early, learn fast, and drive toward production-grade quality with intention and speed
• Use Claude as a core development accelerator for code generation, testing, documentation, and solution design not just as a product capability
 
Scaling Solutions with AI Governance
• Partner with Brillio's AI Governance team to validate, harden, and evolve prototypes into production-grade, enterprise-ready systems.
• Apply responsible AI principles bias review, explainability, HIPAA compliance, audit logging, and model monitoring as a standard part of every build.
• Document solutions clearly and completely so they can be handed off, scaled, and maintained by broader engineering teams without rework.
• Contribute to Brillio's reusable AI accelerator library turning client-specific solutions into patterns that can be deployed across engagements.
 
Business Rhythm & Stakeholder Engagement
• Participate in all client business rhythm meetings sprint reviews, program steering committees, and executive status updates
• Demonstrate progress through live demos and working software not slide decks alone
• Communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical business leaders and build the trust required to move from pilot to scale
• Surface blockers, dependencies, and risks early with clear, solutions-oriented framing
 
Client Immersion & Domain Depth
• Develop genuine expertise in your client's business, their workflows, their data, their competitive pressures, and their regulatory environment
• Understand healthcare operations deeply enough to generate your own problem hypotheses not just respond to inbound requests
• Build relationships with business counterparts that go beyond project delivery, becoming a trusted advisor on what AI can and cannot do in their environment
• Contribute to internal knowledge sharing bring learnings from client engagements back to Brillio's broader applied AI community
 
Must have
•  8+ years of healthcare industry experience: Direct, hands-on experience in health insurance operations (underwriting, claims adjudication, utilization management, product launch) or health system clinical and operational workflows not adjacent or observational. You must understand how these environments actually work.
• Proficiency with Claude (Anthropic) as a development tool. Demonstrated use of the Claude API including prompt engineering, tool use, and agentic patterns to build real applications. Using Claude as a chat interface does not qualify. You must have built with it.
• Full-stack AI engineering capability: Ability to build and ship end-to-end AI applications independently. LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic orchestration, REST API development, and lightweight front-end interfaces sufficient to put a working demo in front of a client.
• Demonstrated ability to prototype at speed: Proven track record of moving from a business conversation to a working AI prototype in days not sprints or quarters. You can show examples of what you built, how fast, and what problem it solved.
• Business articulation and stakeholder communication: Ability to walk into a meeting with healthcare executives and explain what you built, why it matters, what it costs, and what comes next clearly, confidently, and without jargon. This is a non-negotiable for a client-embedded role.
• Maturity to engage at the executive level: Comfortable participating in steering committees, executive briefings, and business rhythm meetings without needing hand-holding. You can hold the room, handle pushback, and demonstrate progress in terms business leaders care about.
• Ability to structure ambiguous problems: When a business leader says 'we need to reduce risk in our underwriting process,' you know how to break that into a scoped AI opportunity with clear inputs, outputs, and success criteria before opening a laptop.
• Quantitative fluency for ROI and impact measurement: Ability to build simple but credible business cases estimating time saved, cost reduced, or revenue protected and translate AI outputs into financial terms that resonate with finance and operations leaders.
 
Strong Preference
• Experience with agentic AI frameworks: Hands-on use of LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent orchestration frameworks to build multi-step, tool-calling AI agents that operate in real workflows.
• Healthcare data standards and regulatory context : Working familiarity with HL7, FHIR, ICD-10, CPT, and claims data structures. Understanding HIPAA requirements, CMS regulations, and FDA digital health guidance as they apply to AI system design and deployment.
• Prior forward-deployed, embedded, or startup engineering experience: You have worked directly inside a client organization, operated in a consulting or embedded delivery model, or built products in a startup environment where you owned the full stack with limited support.
• Experience shipping AI in health insurance technology company or health system: You have navigated the additional complexity of deploying AI where compliance, audit trails, explainability, and data governance are not optional and you know how to move fast without cutting corners that matter.
• Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms or accelerators: You have built solutions with an eye toward reuse creating components, patterns, or frameworks that others on a team can adopt rather than rebuilding from scratch on every engagement.
• Knowledge of AI governance and responsible AI practices in enterprise settings: Familiarity with model risk management, bias evaluation, audit logging, and enterprise AI governance frameworks and experience working alongside governance or compliance teams to get AI systems approved for production use.
 
Who you are?
• A builder first : you are most energized when something tangible exists that didn't exist before
• Equally fluent in the language of healthcare operations and the language of AI engineering and able to switch between them in the same meeting
• Someone who earns trust through working software, not promises you show progress, you don't just report it
• Deeply curious about what AI can do in healthcare and intellectually honest about where it falls short
• Comfortable with ambiguity, urgency, and high stakes you thrive when the path is unclear and the expectation is still high

postings.title: AI Engineer
postings.description:
Brillio is the partner of choice for many Fortune 1000 companies seeking to turn disruption into a competitive advantage through innovative digital adoption. Backed by Bain Capital private equity and Orogen Group, and growing rapidly since its inception, Brillio is one of the fastest growing digital technology service providers. We help clients harness the transformative potential of the four superpowers of technology - cloud computing, internet of things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI), and mobility. Born digital in 2014, we apply Customer Experience Solutions, Data Analytics and AI, Digital Infrastructure and Security, and Platform and Product Engineering expertise to help clients quickly innovate for growth, create digital products, build service platforms, and drive smarter, data-driven performance.

With delivery locations across the United States, Romania, Canada, Mexico, and India, our growing global workforce of over 5500 Brillians blends the latest technology and design thinking with digital fluency to solve complex business problems and drive competitive differentiation for our clients. Brillio was awarded ‘Great Place To Work consistently. Learn more www.Brillio.com.

Role Title: Full Stack AI Engineer
Location: Coppell, TX
Experience: 0–2 Years

Type: On-site 

The Role

Brillio is seeking motivated and technically skilled Full Stack AI Engineers to join our growing engineering team. This role focuses on building cloud-native, full-stack applications and integrating artificial intelligence capabilities through hands-on development, rapid prototyping, and modern software engineering practices.

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in programming and application development, with knowledge of Java, Python, React, and Node.js, along with experience developing agentic AI applications.

This is an exciting opportunity for early-career engineers to work with emerging AI technologies, contribute to innovative application development, and gain practical experience delivering modern digital solutions.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain Java-based microservices and modern web applications.

- Build responsive, scalable frontend applications using React and backend services using Node.js.

- Develop and integrate AI services, intelligent agents, and AI-powered development accelerators into applications.

- Contribute to the development of agentic AI applications and intelligent automation workflows.

- Build prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions to evaluate new technologies and business use cases.

- Collaborate with engineering teams to develop, test, troubleshoot, and deliver software solutions.

- Support cloud-native application development using AWS or Microsoft Azure.

- Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, Codex, or similar platforms to accelerate development.

- Participate in application testing, debugging, performance optimization, and production delivery.

- Stay current with emerging AI technologies, software engineering practices, and development tools.

What We Are Looking For?

- 0–2 years of software engineering or application development experience, including relevant internships or hands-on project experience.

- Strong computer science fundamentals, programming knowledge, and problem-solving capabilities.

- Knowledge of Java/J2EE, Python, Node.js, and React.

- Understanding of Java microservices and modern full-stack application development.

- Experience developing agentic AI applications or integrating AI agents into software solutions.

- Familiarity with GitHub Copilot, Claude, Codex, or similar AI-assisted development tools.

- Exposure to AWS or Microsoft Azure cloud development environments.

- Ability to build, test, debug, and enhance software applications.

- Strong learning agility and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, particularly generative AI and intelligent automation.

- Excellent communication, collaboration, and analytical skills.

- Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced engineering environment.

Candidates should demonstrate the below listed critical leadership qualities:

Customer Advocacy – Lead with the client's business priorities and build relationships grounded in relevance, trust and measurable value.

The role will also provide leadership and governance for US HR Operations, benefits, and immigration and mobility activities, ensuring consistent employee experiences, operational effectiveness, regulatory compliance, and alignment with broader business priorities.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity requiring a strong combination of strategic HR partnering, operational expertise, executive presence, people leadership, and sound judgment.

We are looking for an experienced AWS Data Architect with strong hands-on expertise in designing and implementing scalable cloud-based data solutions.

Role Brief: Brillio is building a legal function that operates as a business enabler. This role is designed for an early-career lawyer who wants to work directly with business teams on contracts, deals, and decisions.
 
What you will do?
Review and negotiate contracts (NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, vendor agreements) 
Partner with sales, finance, and delivery teams on deal execution 
Evaluate and prioritize legal risk vs business outcomes 
Build and improve templates, clause libraries, and playbooks 
Support compliance areas (data privacy, employment, cross-border basics) 
Contribute to legal operations efficiency (standardization, speed, simplification) 
What we are looking for?
0–2 years’ experience in corporate law (contracts-focused) 
Graduate from a top-tier law school 
Exposure to contract drafting/review through internships or early roles 
Strong structured thinking and communication clarity 
Should be able to demonstrate experience working with AI tools
A qualified lawyer
Willingness to work out of office
US Citizen/GC holder
Good to have?
Experience in corporate law firms or in-house teams 
Exposure to technology, consulting, or startup environments 
Familiarity with cross-border contracts / global work 
What will differentiate you?
Prioritizes speed, clarity, and outcomes over perfection 
Translates legal language into business decisions 
Demonstrates ownership early in career 
Has contributed to templates, automation, or process improvements 
What this role is not?
Not litigation-focused 
Not purely advisory or academic 
Not a back-office function removed from the business 
What you get?
Exposure to global contracts and leadership stakeholders 
Opportunity to build and shape legal processes early 
Fast-track path to business-aligned legal leadership 


 
We are not hiring for experience alone. We are hiring for potential, judgment, and ability to operate in ambiguity. This role is not for a traditional lawyer. We’re hiring someone who can operate at the intersection of legal, business, and execution, early in their career, but ready to own outcomes. This will require ability to deliver faster, operate in culturally diverse leadership team and navigate through dynamic business environment. Apply only if you are willing to thrive in such an environment.

postings.title: Principal Architect, CPQ
postings.description:
Principal Architect - CPQ product will own the end-to-end architecture of an AI-native platform built on frontier AI models and agentic workflows. Define the technical vision across product architecture, data platforms, pricing engines, knowledge systems, and AI services while making critical build-vs-buy, platform, and model strategy decisions. Partner closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to create a scalable, enterprise-grade solution that transforms complex sales and pricing processes through automation and intelligence. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise, architectural rigor, and the ability to attract and mentor high-caliber engineering talent.



What will you own?
• Define the architecture for a hyperscaler and LLM-agnostic product built to run on customer infrastructure - not a platform-locked implementation.
• Design the semantic data core: graph-based modeling with typed relationships, multi-tenant isolation, and provenance.
• Architect agentic services - tool-using LLM agents, orchestration, guardrails, and retrieval grounding - as first-class product capabilities.
• Set standards for async API design, state machines, code generation/templating, and draft-to-active data lifecycles.
• Lead technical delivery end-to-end, mentor engineers, and make the build-vs-buy and model-selection calls.

Must-Have Experience:
• 15+ years building software, with a proven record of shipping real products 0-to-1 through scale - not just running projects.
• Core LLM engineering: designing agentic systems with frontier models (Claude / GPT) - tool / function calling, agent skills, multi-step orchestration, and memory.
• Production RAG: embeddings, vector search, chunking and re-ranking, semantic field-mapping, and grounding model output over enterprise data.
• Prompt & context engineering: structured / JSON output, schema validation, evals and regression harnesses, guardrails, and cost / latency / quality trade-offs.
• Strong in Python and modern JS/TS (React / Vite); async services, graph / semantic data modeling, containers, and cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP).

Nice to Have:
• CPQ / quote-to-cash or enterprise SaaS exposure. Salesforce or Revenue Cloud familiarity is a plus, not a requirement - this is a non-Salesforce-native product.

Candidates should demonstrate the below listed critical leadership qualities:
• Customer Advocacy - Ensures customer success on stated and unstated business priorities through strategic advice and market leading solutions.
• Owner’s Mindset - Is passionate about Brillio’s business, deeply committed to its success and makes decisions that are in the best interest of the firm.
• Innovation Ethos - Embraces ambiguity and adopts relentless experimentation to challenge current practices and enable continuous growth.
• Execution with Pace - Displays agility to deliver high quality results in the face of changing stakeholder expectations.
• Big Picture Thinking - Creates a common definition of shared success and sets bold targets that inspire the team towards new horizons.
• Winning Through Teams - Enables a culture of collaboration and empowers teams to "raise their game” to create a winning formula.

Brillio is one of the fastest growing digital technology service providers and a partner of choice for many Fortune 1000 companies seeking to turn disruption into a competitive advantage through innovative digital adoption. Brillio, renowned for its world-class professionals, referred to as "Brillians", distinguishes itself through their capacity to seamlessly integrate cutting-edge digital and design thinking skills with an unwavering dedication to client satisfaction.

Brillio's relentless commitment to providing an exceptional experience to its Brillians and nurturing their full potential consistently garners them the Great Place to Work® certification year after year.

We are seeking a high-energy, net new Sales Director to drive growth for our ServiceNow advisory, implementation, and managed services business in the UK. The ideal candidate will have a strong network within the ServiceNow ecosystem and a proven track record of selling ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, and related ServiceNow propositions into enterprise clients.

# Azure Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric | Data Migration & Modernization

Experience:5–8 Years 

Locations: Bangalore | Hyderabad | Pune | Chennai | Gurgaon 

Employment Type: Full-time

Build the Next Generation of Data Platforms with Us

Are you passionate about modern data engineering and excited about building scalable solutions on Microsoft Fabric and Azure

We are looking for an experienced Azure Data Engineer with strong Microsoft Fabric expertise to join our Data Engineering team. In this role, you will work on enterprise-scale data modernization initiatives, helping migrate legacy SQL databases, ETL workloads, and existing data platforms to a modern Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.

This is an opportunity to work hands-on with Microsoft Fabric, Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, SQL, Python and PySpark, while solving complex data migration and engineering challenges.

What You’ll Do

- Lead the technical implementation of data modernization and migration projects, moving legacy SQL databases, ETL workloads, and data processing solutions to Microsoft Fabric.

- Analyze existing SQL, ETL, and data integration workloads to identify migration strategies, dependencies, complexity, performance challenges, and optimization opportunities.

- Design and develop scalable and reliable data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric Data Factory, notebooks, and related Fabric services.

- Build modern data engineering solutions using Fabric Lakehouse, Warehouse and OneLake.

- Develop and optimize data transformation and processing logic using SQL, Python and PySpark.

- Design reusable engineering components and establish standards around code organization, naming conventions, logging, monitoring, and deployment practices.

- Troubleshoot complex pipeline failures, data quality issues, and production performance bottlenecks.

- Implement efficient ingestion patterns, including incremental data loads and Change Data Capture where required.

- Work with engineering and analytics teams to ensure reliable integration between data platforms and reporting solutions.

- Conduct code reviews, mentor other data engineers, and drive engineering best practices across the team.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Have Skills

5–8 years of overall experience in Data Engineering.

- At least 3 years of hands-on experience in Azure Data Engineering and data migration/modernization projects.

- Strong hands-on expertise with **Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering

- Experience with **Microsoft Fabric Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse and OneLake**.

- Advanced **SQL** skills for data transformation, migration, integration, and performance optimization.

- Strong programming experience in **Python and PySpark**.

- Hands-on experience migrating **legacy ETL and SQL-based workloads to Azure/Fabric environments**.

- Experience with **Azure DevOps** for CI/CD and deployment automation.

- Working knowledge of **Git** and collaborative source-control practices.

- Good understanding of Microsoft Fabric workspaces and modern data engineering best practices.

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities in production data environments.

## Good to Have

- Experience with **data modeling, dimensional modeling, and data partitioning strategies**.

- Knowledge of **data quality, security, and data governance** practices within Azure environments.

- Experience with monitoring, logging, and performance tuning of large-scale data pipelines.

- Hands-on knowledge of **Change Data Capture (CDC)** and incremental ingestion patterns.

- Familiarity with **Power BI** and working closely with BI/analytics teams.

- Experience providing technical guidance or mentoring junior/mid-level Data Engineers.

## Education & Preferred Certifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

Job requirements
Infra & Cloud Security Specialist Role Summary Hands-on Infra & Cloud Security Specialist is responsible for identifying, solutioning, and remediating vulnerabilities across on-prem and Azure-centric environments. This role is execution heavy. You will work directly on Linux, Windows, AKS, and container security issues and take ownership from finding to closure, while following defined security standards and automation practices. When vulnerabilities show up, you don’t just flag them. You fix them. Key Responsibilities

- Perform hands-on vulnerability remediation across cloud, on-prem, and hybrid environments.

- Use Wiz to triage vulnerabilities, analyze root causes, define remediation actions, and drive closure.

- Remediate vulnerabilities across:

- Linux and Windows OS (patching, hardening, configuration fixes)

- Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters

- Container images and registries

- Implement and adhere to defined security baselines for Azure infrastructure and platform services.

- Fix misconfigurations across ACS / cloud security posture controls, identity, networking, and storage.

- Work closely with DevOps, platform, and application teams to remediate security issues in building and deployment pipelines.

- Execute and support automation for:

- OS and image hardening

- Patch management

- Configuration drift and compliance checks

- Support IAM, RBAC, and privileged access controls implementation and reviews.

- Participate in audits, security assessments, and vulnerability review discussions.

- Create and maintain remediation documentation, runbooks, and implementation guides.

- Support engineers with practical guidance on OS, cloud, and container security remediation.

Technical Competencies

- Hands-on experience using Wiz for vulnerability identification and remediation tracking.

- Strong expertise in Linux and Windows OS security, including:

- OS hardening

- Patch remediation

- Configuration and package-level fixes

- Practical experience remediating vulnerabilities in AKS clusters, including nodes and workloads.

- Good understanding of container security, including:

- Image vulnerabilities

- Base image hardening

- Registry and runtime considerations

- Working knowledge of Azure security services, identity, networking, and storage security.

- Experience using Terraform and Ansible for remediation or security automation.

- Understanding of cloud security posture management, IAM concepts, and least privilege models.

- Configuring firewalls, VPNs, access control and conditional access policy, and security patches.

- Managing cloud security services (e.g., Entra ID), ensuring compliance with security best practices and regulatory requirements.

- Managing certificates and secure configurations.

- Managing SCA, SAST, DAST and Secrets Platforms and governance

Behavioral Competencies

- Strong ownership mindset and execution focus.

- Solution-oriented approach to security findings.

- Clear communicator with engineers and platform teams.

- Comfortable explaining remediation actions and trade-offs.

- Values clean documentation and repeatable processes.

Experience & Qualifications

- 7–9 years in infrastructure, cloud, or platform security roles.

- Mandatory hands-on experience securing both Linux and Windows in enterprise environments.

- Hands-on experience remediating vulnerabilities in AKS clusters, container images, and OS platforms.

- Understanding golden image patching and hardening concepts.

- Proven experience closing vulnerabilities, not just reporting them.

- Kubernetes and container security experience is required.

- AZ-500 preferred; CISSP or CCSP is a plus.
